name: Caudalie

card.summary: A French skincare brand built on grape-seed polyphenols, used for antioxidant, hydrating and brightening skincare routines.
card.note: Brand claims about efficacy come largely from the company.

quick.overview:
Caudalie is a French skincare brand founded in 1995 by Mathilde and Bertrand Thomas in Bordeaux. Its products are built around polyphenols from grape seeds and vines, marketed for antioxidant, hydrating, brightening and anti-ageing care.

People use its serums, mists and creams as part of a skincare routine aimed at smoother, more even, glowing skin.
quick.how: The range covers cleansers, serums, moisturisers, masks, body care and a facial mist, used as ordinary daily skincare. Lines include resveratrol-based anti-ageing products and Vinopure for oily skin.
quick.risks: As with any cosmetic, fragrance or botanical ingredients can irritate sensitive skin. Wikipedia notes its own article on the company has a promotional tone, so company-sourced claims warrant care.

lead: Caudalie is a French skincare company founded in 1995 by Mathilde and Bertrand Thomas after research by a Bordeaux pharmacy professor, Joseph Vercauteren, showed grape-seed polyphenols could act as strong antioxidants [1][2]. Its products draw on grape and grapevine extracts from the family's Bordeaux vineyard, Smith Haut Lafitte [2].
For appearance, the pitch is antioxidant, hydrating and brightening skincare: serums, creams, masks and a facial mist. Its first Vinotherapie spa opened in 1999 [1][2].
Lines named in coverage include the Beauty Elixir mist (1997), Vinoperfect brightening (2005), Premier Cru anti-ageing (2009) and Resveratrol-Lift (2020), with Vinopure for oily skin [1].

angle.text: Caudalie products are used as everyday skincare aimed at glow and an even tone. The brand's claims rest on grape-seed polyphenol research and its own testing.

paras: The founders noticed grape harvest effects on skin and met Professor Vercauteren in 1993, which led to the brand's launch in 1995 [1]. The first Vinotherapie Spa opened in 1999 at Les Sources de Caudalie [1][2].
Skincare, body care, fragrance and masks based on grape and grapevine ingredients [2]. The company describes most ranges as 95% natural-origin [1].
